items.title: Earl King Interview, 1980-04-10
items.q: on the floor, like the Lil' Isaac James melody line.

ctx.x: So the guitar, when you played, was basically to fill out the bad part? Yeah.

Was melody lines, in other words? Yeah, on the floor, like the Lil' Isaac James melody line. Oh. And stuff like that, depending on the song like that. Then you really wasn't too key on having too much pronunciation, hit the other things, anything like that. No hotbooks and stuff on it.
Can you say something in general about the use of the guitar in the Wallace music? Outside of the solo instrument? How was the guitar was used in the Wallace music?
